Cherry Vanilla Yogurt Parfait
By: Gayle B
Published: Wednesday, March 18, 2015 - 8:46am

Ingredients




2 cups vanilla Greek yogurt
1 cups granola
1 cup DOVE® Fruit Cherries, halved

Preparation

1 Spread 1/2 cup vanilla Greek yogurt onto the bottom of a small glass or bowl. 2 Sprinkle 1/2 cup of granola on top. 3 Add 1/4 cup of DOVE® Fruit Cherries on top of granola. 4 Repeat with second layer. 5 Serve immediately or refridgerate until ready to serve. 6 Enjoy!

About

This Cherry Vanilla Yogurt Parfait is jam-packed with chocolate cherries, crunchy granola clusters, and creamy vanilla Greek yogurt.
